text_block_list.text:
Work had kept me until late at night. 
Walking at a brisk pace in hopes of 
getting home quickly, I ran into Tanino 
Gimlet.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Hey. We meet again.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. The dark is a paradise, yet also a 
prison. I cannot afford to let it erode me 
too deeply.

While exchanging words that made sense and 
didn't make sense at the same time, we 
walked along, until—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Dammit... It still won't open!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Agh, geez...! It's all because you were 
dawdling around!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hah!? You took forever packing up your 
stuff too, didn't you!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: These voices—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Vodka. Bearer of your own aesthetics. 
What on earth has transpired?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Is that you over there, Gim-senpai!? 
The gym door won't open!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
We stayed too late, so maybe that's why... 
Should we contact someone?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The door is indeed robust. But that is 
precisely where its value lies... It is 
worthy of destruction...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The golden opportunity to display my 
might... Hahaha!! Then I shall not 
hesitate in the slightest— I, 
myself—shall—!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heheh... Resorting to brute force right 
off the bat, are we? How utterly fearless.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—What. Have you come to pour cold water on 
my passion?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No, quite the contrary. Just a moment ago, 
I succeeded in formulating a reagent 
capable of curing resin at ultra-high 
speed.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I was pondering how best to test it 
out—and then you appeared. A bold soul, 
completely unafraid of committing a crime.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: A soul unafraid of crime, you say...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Much like an overconfident sinner of the 
northern lands. Regrettably, I am not 
quite that reckless.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, is that so? If it's destruction you 
seek, I was thinking of preparing a 
suitable weapon for you.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: What...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, what a shame, what a shame. I 
thought you of all people wouldn't mind 
tagging along for some slightly rough 
methods.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Hold!! —O wise detective...!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Are you saying you will collaborate...? 
You, a brilliant sage of intellect...!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. My invention combined with your 
decisive power. I am curious to see what 
will happen when they blend together.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The pursuer and the perpetrator, two 
incompatible forces, sharing in crime 
together... Heh.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha!! A plotline absent from the 
original script...!! What utter 
blasphemy!! And what absolute destiny!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent, magnificent!! Then let us 
share the guilt for now, fully prepared to 
face our punishment!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Seems your resolve is set. Then let us 
unleash it with all our might!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I don't get the details, but... looks like 
they got it covered!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's our senpais after all! I'm sure 
they'll manage something!

Those two seemed optimistic, but honestly, 
I had a bad feeling about this. Something 
disastrous was about to happen—!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Alright. The resin has already solidified! 
Now your fist is cloaked in iron armor!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hahahaha!! Splendid, it feels just like 
the steel skin of a dragon-slaying 
hero...!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I have cast off my shackles...!! This urge 
within me was meant for this very 
moment!!!!
(KABOOOOOOOM!!!!)

text_block_list.name: The Two
text_block_list.text: Hahaha!! Ahahaha!! Aaaaaaaaahahahaha!!!!
...What is all this commotion?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
T-The door is...!! It's completely bent 
out of shape...!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I rushed over upon hearing the gym had 
been locked by mistake, and to think it 
was you two.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oops, could that be the arrival of the 
real detective?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Has our crime been exposed to the light of 
day? —Very well. At least I was able to 
witness what lay beyond the story.

Later, Tanino Gimlet and Agnes Tachyon 
were ordered to help repair the door, 
but... somehow, their expressions were 
completely radiant.
That is enough, Tanino Gimlet.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Tch!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I rushed over upon hearing the gym had 
been locked by mistake, and to think it 
was you two.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Just now—were you trying to break the door 
down...!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Aw man, we got caught? How boring...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Tch— So in the end, the plotline strictly 
adheres to the original work, does it...!
